description:
The GPU test helper module re-declares raw HIP allocation, free, copy, and synchronise bindings instead of using the wrappers the crate already provides. Route the helper through those wrappers.

## Background

The redundant `extern "C"` block is at `crates/gf2-kernels-hip/tests/common/mod.rs:18`. The crate exposes an owning device-buffer type with host-to-device and device-to-host copies, plus a checked device-synchronise call in its FFI module. Test code duplicating the raw bindings bypasses the crate's error handling and lifetime management, so a leak or a dropped error status in the helper goes unnoticed.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The test helper allocates and frees device memory through the crate's owning buffer type rather than raw allocation calls.
- [hard] REQ-02: Host-to-device and device-to-host transfers in the helper use the buffer type's copy methods.
- [hard] REQ-03: Device synchronisation in the helper uses the crate's checked FFI wrapper.
- [hard] REQ-04: No `extern "C"` HIP declaration remains in the test helper module.
- [hard] REQ-05: Device-gated tests that use the helper behave unchanged where a supported device is present, and remain correctly gated where one is not.
- [hard] REQ-06: Formatting, clippy with warnings denied, and the crate's host-side build all pass.
title: Replace raw HIP FFI in test helpers with the crate's RAII buffers
